# New York Magazine

> New York Magazine is a premier source for news, culture, politics, entertainment, and lifestyle content with expert product recommendations and curated shopping guides.

New York Magazine operates multiple verticals including Intelligencer (news and politics), The Strategist (product recommendations and deals), and lifestyle coverage across fashion, beauty, home, travel and entertainment. The publication offers both digital and print subscriptions, newsletters, and branded merchandise.

## Key Topics

- News and Politics
- Product Recommendations
- Gift Guides
- Shopping and Deals
- Entertainment
- Culture
- Technology
- Fashion and Style
- Home and Design
- Beauty
- Travel
- Horoscopes
- Magazine Subscription
- Newsletters
- Celebrity Gossip

## Core Sections

- [New York Magazine](https://nymag.com): New York Magazine homepage with news, culture, politics, entertainment and horoscopes.
- [Intelligencer](https://nymag.com/intelligencer): Intelligencer news section covering politics, business, tech and daily briefings.
- [The Strategist](https://nymag.com/strategist): The Strategist product recommendations, shopping deals and gift guides.

## Shopping & Product Recommendations

- [Gift Guides](https://nymag.com/strategist/gift-guides): The Strategist gift guides by recipient and occasion with curated recommendations.
- [Deals and Sales](https://nymag.com/strategist/deals-sales): The Strategist deals and sales roundup with daily discounts across retailers.
- [Beauty](https://nymag.com/strategist/beauty): The Strategist beauty product recommendations for skincare, makeup and grooming.
- [Fashion & Style](https://nymag.com/strategist/fashion): The Strategist fashion recommendations for women, men and kids clothing.
- [Home](https://nymag.com/strategist/home): The Strategist home product recommendations for furniture, bedding and decor.
- [Kitchen](https://nymag.com/strategist/kitchen): The Strategist kitchen product recommendations for cookware and appliances.
- [Travel](https://nymag.com/strategist/travel): The Strategist travel gear recommendations for luggage and travel accessories.

## News & Topics

- [Technology News](https://nymag.com/intelligencer/technology): Intelligencer technology news section covering AI, gadgets and tech trends.

## Subscriptions & Newsletters

- [Magazine Subscription](https://subs.nymag.com/magazine/subscribe/official-subscription.html): Official New York Magazine subscription page with pricing and digital/print options.
- [Gift Subscriptions](https://nymag.com/maglinks/global-02): Gift subscription page for New York Magazine and sister publications.
- [Newsletters](https://nymag.com/newsletters): Newsletter signup directory for New York Magazine and sister publications.

## Shop & Community

- [New York Magazine Shop](https://shop.nymag.com): Official New York Magazine merchandise shop with branded apparel and products.
